records.title: GenEnv: Difficulty-Aligned Co-Evolution Between LLM Agents and Environment Simulators
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.19682. Primary abstract proposes an agent training-data simulator/curriculum and reports task-performance gains; the efficiency is training-data efficiency.

records.title: APRIL: Active Partial Rollouts in Reinforcement Learning to Tame Long-tail Generation
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.18521. Primary abstract explicitly optimizes RL rollout generation during model training, not deployment inference.

records.title: MMQ: Multimodal Mixture-of-Quantization Tokenization for Semantic ID Generation and User Behavioral Adaptation
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.15281. Primary abstract concerns multimodal semantic-ID tokenization for recommendation tasks, outside LLM inference/serving efficiency.
